title: Oval diamond line bracelet, 18K gold
subtitle: The oval cut is the round brilliant stretched — same facet count, same fire, but a longer light path that makes color and brilliance appear at the same moment rather than alternating. In a bracelet, stone after stone in sequence, the ovals don't sit passively side by side — they present their full face in rotation as the wrist moves. Each stone is forward-set, each catching light at its own moment.
